description: Checks an agent's JSON output against a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 keywords: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, const, length, pattern, minimum/maximum, item counts). Returns valid yes/no, each error with its path and the value with disallowed fields removed. $ref, allOf/anyOf/oneOf, if/then and format return an error instead of passing silently. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

value.description: The JSON value to check (any JSON)
